build_forward_kinematics_factory: build a forward kinematics autograd function for a robot using ForwardKinematicsFactory
create_fk_functions: create forward kinematics functions for a robot using get_forward_kinematics_fns
test_forward_kinematics: test forward kinematics by computing link poses from joint angles

compute_body_jacobian: compute the body jacobian for each link given joint angles
